Definition: from G2016; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future):--appearing, brightness.
BiblicalUsage: Epiphaneia is an appearing, a manifestation — the advent of Christ, past and future. He hath abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel by His appearing; we look for the blessed hope and the glorious appearing of our great God and Saviour; and there is a crown of righteousness for all them that love His appearing.
TheologicalSignificance: He appeared once to abolish death, and He will appear again to crown those who love Him, and my life is lived between the two. I hold that the appearing has two faces, and loving His appearing is the surest sign I am ready for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
